newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisie Lait first half profit drops.
newsitem.headline: Tunisie Lait first half profit drops.

text.p: Tunisian milk firm Tunisie Lait gross profits dropped to 953,000 dinars during the first half of 1996 compared to 1.54 million dinars during the same period last year, results published on Friday showed.
Turnover was higher, at 24.68 million compared with 19.26 million.
Net profits in 1995 were 1.33 million, down 38.77 percent from 2.17 million in 1994.
The firm has a capital of 6.5 million dinars. Its shares last traded at 24.77 dinars on the Tunis Stock Exchange.
This week it launched an international tender for advice on how to improve its management and profitability. ($=0.97 dinar)
